reviewed.disposition: Named atomic writes persist explicit legacy capture manifests and retained capture history. Initial capture requires writer exclusion and maintenance scope; recovery requires owned maintenance, unchanged original inventory, no cutover marker/candidate and bounded recorded membership.

Writes candidate task inventory, preparation manifest and recovery intent. Candidate work is maintenance-scoped, validates integrity and portable round-trip parity, checkpoints before PREPARED and retains interrupted candidate files; recovery refuses rebuilding after publication or cutover.

Writes rollback preparation and owner-adoption journals under retained maintenance exclusion. READY requires current admission parity, matching native marker and independently verified native backup. Interrupted backups are retained rather than overwritten.

Writes explicit rollback source-stage manifests during exclusive copy and owner recovery. Stage bindings, captured source membership and bytes, prepared native backup and exact owner continuity are revalidated; incomplete copies are retained independently.

Writes rollback publication and owner-adoption journals. Publication requires operator exclusion of native writes and verified source stage; native authority is retained before legacy roots are restored. Recovery validates partitions, exact owner chain and closed native WAL before adopting metadata.

Writes explicit replacement preparation intents in maintenance callbacks. Writer exclusion, exact owner continuity, unchanged source backup and validated incoming snapshot precede archival/publication. Recovery refuses conflicting publication checkpoints.

Writes explicit restore publication/preparation journals under maintenance ownership. Fresh restore refuses existing authority; replacement requires verified outgoing archival. Published database logical parity, integrity, domain validation and referenced attachments are checked before ACTIVE; owner recovery revalidates recorded journals.

Writes retained outgoing replacement manifests through an owner-checked helper. Preparation validates outgoing authority, refuses live operation leases, records baseline before allocation, retains independent backup and requires closed connections before READY.

Writes explicit replacement archival journals and exact owner-adoption metadata. Incoming/outgoing bindings and active-root partitions are verified before root moves; complete archive verification precedes ARCHIVED.

Writes missing allocation metadata and owner-checked rebuild intent. Reconstruction requires matching preparation baseline; ambiguous membership and changed outgoing authority are refused. Interrupted outgoing attempts and manifests remain independently retained.

limitations: All 28 named static caller modules from increment 808 are classified across increments 809-811; this is a bounded role audit, not proof of every caller invariant.
Dynamic imports, external callers and other write primitives require separate inventory and review.
Current platform and complete public workflow acceptance remain independently open.
